why: Every box costs the same one slot, so the only thing that matters is units per box: sort, then take the locally best. Fill slots from the richest type down until the truck is full.
hints: Every box uses exactly one slot no matter what it holds. So which box would you always rather load first?
Sort the types by unitsPerBox, descending. Swapping any loaded box for a richer unloaded one can only help, so the greedy fill is optimal.
Walk the sorted types; take min(boxes, remaining capacity) of each, add take * units, stop when capacity hits 0. O(n log n).
pitfalls: capacity = 0 or an empty list: the answer is 0.
Types with 0 boxes or 0 units just contribute nothing; do not crash on them.
Do not mutate the input arrays: sort a zipped copy.
